title: How the ZIA Ansible collection updates a custom URL category
aliases: ziacloud ansible url category remove urls fails
Request body is invalid url category ansible

prose.text: This covers the `zia_url_categories` module of the ZIA Ansible collection. The Terraform provider's equivalent path is in [[zia.terraform.url-categories]].

prose.label: Reported failure.
prose.text: {{issue-134-remove-rejected}} Why the service rejects the body is open {{gap:issue-134-cause}}.

incremental-diff.statement: On update, the module compares the current and desired `urls` and `db_categorized_urls` lists and, when either list has additions or removals, sends the removals as a REMOVE_FROM_LIST call and the additions as an ADD_TO_LIST call instead of replacing the category.

quotes: # Use incremental updates: ADD_TO_LIST and/or REMOVE_FROM_LIST

remove-payload-shape.statement: The REMOVE_FROM_LIST payload is a copy of the module's whole desired category in which `urls` and `db_categorized_urls` hold only the entries to remove, or are dropped when there are none to remove, so the other category fields travel with the call.

quotes: Terraform pattern: send full desired category structure for other attrs,
but URL lists contain ONLY the items to add/remove (not the full list)

issue-134-remove-rejected.statement: Collection issue #134, still open, reports that from collection 2.1.0 a `zia_url_categories` task with `state: present` that has to remove URLs fails because the REMOVE_FROM_LIST call returns HTTP 400 `Request body is invalid.`, leaving the stale URLs on the category. The reporter says the same pattern worked before the incremental-update change and names pinning the collection below 2.1.0 as a workaround.

quotes: Starting in collection **2.1.0** (PR [#108](https://github.com/zscaler/ziacloud-ansible/pull/108)), updates use incremental `REMOVE_FROM_LIST` / `ADD_TO_LIST` instead of a full category replace.
The `REMOVE_FROM_LIST` call returns HTTP 400 (`Request body is invalid.`), so URLs are not removed from Zscaler and the Ansible task fails.
Updating an existing ZIA custom URL category with `zscaler.ziacloud.zia_url_categories` (`state: present`) fails when the module needs to remove URLs.
The same playbook pattern worked before the incremental-update change

issue-134-cause.title: Why the ZIA API rejects the module's REMOVE_FROM_LIST body
issue-134-cause.blocks: saying that a REMOVE_FROM_LIST body carrying the other category fields, or a large removal, is accepted
issue-134-cause.detail: The reporter suspects the extra category fields in the payload, list parameters left unset being treated as empty desired lists, or very large removal batches; none is confirmed and no maintainer reply is captured. Send REMOVE_FROM_LIST once with the module's full payload and once with only the entries to remove, and once with a large list.
